#### Why do I write essays?

The original idea was to write full articles, but given the technical rigor that demands compared to an essay, it makes more sense for a student to start here. Essays let me explore a topic and test out a perspective without needing the same level of formal apparatus a research piece would require — they're a space to think out loud, work through an idea, and see where it leads before committing to something heavier.
